title: Odd majority Fourier weight tail
statement: For each integer $k\geq 0$, let $a_k=0$ when $k$ is even and, when $k$ is odd, let $a_k=\frac{2}{k2^k}\binom{k-1}{(k-1)/2}$. Set $W_k=\frac{2}{\pi}a_k$ and $T_k=\sum_{j>k}W_j$. As the integer $q$ tends to infinity, $T_{2q+1}$ tends to $0$.
